groups.name: Characters from The Good Place
groups.explanation: Eleanor Shellstrop, Chidi Anagonye, Tahani Al-Jamil, and Jason Mendoza are the four main human characters sent to The Good Place in NBC's The Good Place.

groups.name: Apple TV+ original series
groups.explanation: Severance, Ted Lasso, The Morning Show, and Slow Horses all premiered as original series on Apple TV+.

groups.name: TV characters who are therapists or psychiatrists
groups.explanation: Jennifer Melfi (The Sopranos) is Tony Soprano's psychiatrist; Niles Crane (Frasier) is a practicing psychiatrist; Tobias Fünke (Arrested Development) is a trained therapist (and never-nude); Paul Weston (In Treatment) is a therapist whose sessions form the entire premise of the show.

groups.name: Cult TV shows cancelled after 2 seasons or fewer
groups.explanation: Firefly (Fox, 1 season, 2002–03), Freaks and Geeks (NBC, 1 season, 1999–2000), Pushing Daisies (ABC, 2 seasons, 2007–09), and Party Down (Starz, 2 seasons, 2009–10) are all beloved cult shows that were cancelled far too soon in their original runs.
